title: Principles of the Slung Ram
summary: Explains how a hanging ram swings on its chains and how a student times a pulse of qi to its low point.

title: The Crew Ram Intermediate Course
summary: A course for crews that already swing a ram, joining haul rhythm, footing and linked-arm drives with shared qi.

title: On Timing the Pendulum Strike
summary: A short treatise on counting a ram's swing, judging a door's give and choosing the moment to strike with qi.

title: A Treatise of Joint Breaching
summary: A treatise on how a crew lifts, advances and strikes as one body, for students who have mastered the plain carry.

title: The Roofed Ram Frame Manual
summary: A manual for working a ram under a hide-covered roof frame, with qi used to stiffen the cover and steady the push.

title: Hand Ram and Hinge Work
summary: A small manual of hand-ram techniques for hinge pins and door frames, suited to narrow stairs and tight passages.

title: Canon of the Heavy Carry

title: Lessons in Barred-Door Breaking
